resources.string: We read incoming SMS only to spot your safety keywords and fire automations. The app is not a default SMS app.
Reads incoming SMS and call info to detect your safety keyword/number, then triggers alarms and sends the alert texts you configured. Not a default SMS or Phone app.

If SMS, Phone, or Call Log show as disabled: Settings -> Apps -> PulseLink -> Permissions -> enable SMS, Phone, and Call logs. Tap the 3-dot menu and pick \"Allow disallowed permissions\" if prompted.
Required so your safety automations react instantly to SMS or call triggers.
Allow access to call info for automations
Used to detect trusted calls that should fire your safety automations and to show who triggered the alert. Not set as default Phone.
Open Settings -> Apps -> PulseLink -> Permissions -> Call logs and set to Allow so call-based triggers work.
